Theme

pop verb and noun

also crack, crackle, popping sound

classical

crepō, crepāre, crepuī, crepitum

verb, first conjugation

crack, pop, make a sharp noise

crepō is usually treated as imitative.

Other words

  • crepitus, crepitūs m. — cracking or popping sound

    noun, fourth declension · classical

  • crepitō, crepitāre, crepitāvī, crepitātum — crackle repeatedly

    verb, first conjugation · also used · classical

Examples

  • Vēsīca crepat.

    The balloon pops.composed

See also burst, balloon.

SourcesLewis & Short: crepo · Lewis & Short: crepito
